provenance.notes: SIMULATED plant (e003 sim-scenario-v3) with PUBLIC weather, price and carbon (mixed). run_label=seed 100, guard=context. Hardware: {'device': 'cuda', 'python': '3.13.16', 'platform': 'Linux-6.6.159+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39', 'torch': '2.11.0+cu130', 'gpu': 'NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition'}

scenario.note: job schedule follows the run seed; the scenario synthetic environment is replaced by the public environment; plant SIMULATED

environment.kind: public weather, day-ahead price and carbon via heatwave.sim_env.public_environment (mixed: simulated plant, public exogenous series)
environment.week_start_rule: seed s runs the week starting at scenario start_utc + 7 x (s - 100) days (all weeks in the test period, 2026-05-01 onward)

sites.site-a: Bay Area weather, CAISO NP15 day-ahead LMP, CAISO carbon
sites.site-b: Frankfurt weather, DE-LU day-ahead price x usd_per_eur, DE carbon

leakage_rules.J: plan built from jobs with submit_s <= origin only; horizon <= known_future_horizon_s
leakage_rules.P: same plan as J (phase of the planned steps)
leakage_rules.W: Open-Meteo previous_day1 (day-ahead) forecast, available from valid time minus 24 h; never the actual (ERA5-based) outdoor temperature the plant used
leakage_rules.C: day-ahead price, available from 13:00 local market time on the day before delivery (assumed publication time; unpublished steps are NaN); carbon: seasonal-naive forecast (actual of 24 h earlier, available 23 h before its hour); the simulator's actual-carbon export is not used

design.bootstrap: moving-block bootstrap over origins (block = ceil(horizon / origin stride)), same resampled origins for every stream and config (paired); cluster bootstrap over seeds in delta_wql_cluster_ci95; 1000 replicates, 95% percentile intervals
design.const_guard_rule: covariate rows (window, channel) whose context part is constant and that are not 0/1 indicators are replaced by zeros before the model (no in-context evidence of a relation to the series); counts in constant_rows_zeroed
design.split: simulator test seeds 100-109 (fixed split; no fitting on any series)

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
